artifact_naming: tests/golden/<artifact>.<channel>.golden where <artifact> is pr13-<nn>-<command>--<scenario> and <channel> is json, text, or stderr; the artifact ID is the stable name; bytes are compared exactly, with no normalization
determinism: every pinned byte is deterministic by construction (INV-005): pinned daemon now, content-addressed handles (Blake3Identity), counter request identifiers, no clock read anywhere (cost.wall_ms is absent because nothing measures it), canonical JSON member order; asserted by two_independent_provisionings_render_byte_identical_artifacts over two separately built daemons. The only timestamps in any artifact are the fixture's declared now, never a read clock.
exit: golden tests pin JSON, exit codes, and concise terminal output
projection_contract: contract::divergence is empty between the text and json channels of every pinned scenario (the_terminal_body_of_every_pinned_scenario_is_a_pure_projection_of_its_json); pretty is text plus exactly one command label line (pretty_is_text_plus_the_command_label_for_every_pinned_scenario)

residuals.note: the CLI's generated idempotency key is a function of the operation name and a call counter, not of the request body (continuum_cli::wire::Connection::envelope); scenario 06 pins the resulting content collision as current behaviour so the fix is visible when it lands. This is a retained defect record, not a certification.
